_comment: Event Director cards. Considered hourly; conditions are world state, never pure chance. intensity >= 2 respects the calm window after a crisis. 'manual' cards only fire from effects or code.

first_knock.caption: [the pipes knock — three, two, three — then nothing]

exhale_surge.toast: The Deep exhales. Warm, sour air rises from the vents below the Sink.
exhale_surge.caption: [a long, low breath moves through the rock]

inhale_damp.toast: The cavern draws breath. Damp air settles over the lake.

moth_swarm.toast: Lampmoths drift in from the grove and settle on the glowbeets.
effects: notice:hesper:Hesper counted the lampmoths over your plots. Twice.

cistern_low.toast: The cistern is getting low. Mags is boiling the same water twice.

grist_hum.caption: [deep in the rock, something hums a single held note]

tremor.toast: Tremor! Pipes are cracking under the lane.
tremor.caption: [the ground lurches; brick gives way somewhere below]

tremor_late.toast: Tremor! Pipes are cracking under the lane.
tremor_late.caption: [the ground lurches; brick gives way somewhere below]

quietlight.caption: [one by one, every lamp in Wick goes out]

valve_turn.caption: [iron grinds on iron; far below, a long sigh of air]

knock.caption: [knock knock knock — knock knock — knock knock knock]

damp_season.toast: The damp season. The lake breathes out, and somewhere on the Commons a child starts to cough.
damp_season.caption: [a child coughing, somewhere across the Commons]

strain_found.toast: Grist left a crate of salvage at Hesper's door. She has not come out since.

meeting_1.toast: Mags is calling everyone to the Lantern House at Dimming. 'Everyone. I mean it. Bring a cup.'

medicine_arrives.toast: A crate came up Odile's down-river chute in the night.

wren_fades.caption: [the pipe-heads knock once in the night, slowly, and then not again]

pell_visits.toast: Pell rode the lift up in the night and is standing by the lake with their mouth open.

wren_visits.toast: Wren Askew came up on the morning cage and is sitting at the quiet table. It is no longer quiet.

ways_rumble.caption: [far below, the sound of rock moving, slowly, all night]

meeting_2.toast: Mags is calling the town together again at Dimming. A vote, this time.

heart_gathering.toast: Wick has gone down to the Heart. Everyone. Mags brought soup.
